name: Scroll Panels
description: Three panels that together complete a single image; on scroll they open slightly, flip, and the text behind each panel is revealed.
interactionNotes: The further you scroll, the further it goes: first the side panels open outward and the whole trio shrinks a little, then the panels flip one by one and the text on their backs appears, and finally the whole group moves up slightly. Scrolling back reverses everything — the motion is entirely in your hands.

props.name: items
props.description: Up to three cards; each card is `{ title, description, bgColor, textColor, kicker? }` and sits behind one panel. If omitted, the component's own three Persian panels are used.

props.name: imageSrc
props.description: The shared image of the three panels — a wide image looks best. If omitted, the online default is kept.

props.name: className
props.description: Applies to the scroll track container; an `h-` class lets you change the 400vh height for tighter spaces.

props.name: containerRef
props.description: The scroll area to track — for example a div with `overflow-y-auto`. If omitted, the page itself is tracked.

props.name: paneHeight
props.description: Height of the sticky stage. For embedding inside a box, give a fixed value, not a percentage.

props.name: peak
props.description: How many pixels the side panels open outward at their peak before returning.

props.name: flipStart
props.description: Where in the scroll progress the flip starts (0 to 1); a lower value means it turns over sooner.

props.name: innerRadius
props.description: Maximum radius of the panels' inner corners while they collapse.

tips: Choose a wide, landscape image; the trio crops it, so it's better to keep the subject in the middle.
To embed it in a scrollable box: pass that box as `containerRef`, set `paneHeight` to a fixed value, and shorten the track height with `className="h-…"`.
Keep the kicker short (a two-word phrase); a long one gets cut off with `truncate`.
Each panel's color is changed through the card's own props — the colors are content and don't mix with the site theme.
